query:
SELECT 
  total_plants,
  total_terroirs,
  total_relations,
  plants_with_terroirs,
  terroirs_with_plants,
  ROUND(plants_with_terroirs * 100.0 / total_plants, 1) as plant_coverage_pct,
  ROUND(terroirs_with_plants * 100.0 / total_terroirs, 1) as terroir_coverage_pct
FROM (
  SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plants) as total_plants,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM terroirs) as total_terroirs,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plant_terroirs) as total_relations,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT plant_id) FROM plant_terroirs) as plants_with_terroirs,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT terroir_id) FROM plant_terroirs) as terroirs_with_plants
) stats
